operations.name: local-recipe-review
operations.old_string: If the requested record is absent and your available tools cannot read it, answer in the requested format now. Leave its identity and outcome unknown and ask for the record or a permitted read.
operations.new_string: If the requested record is absent and your available tools cannot read it, answer in the requested format now. Leave its identity and outcome unknown and ask for the record or a permitted read. For JSON receipts, emit a literal null for receipt_id when its ID is unknown, not an empty string; use null for any other identity field only when it is likewise unknown.

operations.name: local-recipe-review
operations.old_string:
Copy the returned `stop_receipt` values. Its `stopped:null` means the
stop was not verified.
operations.new_string:
Copy the returned `stop_receipt` values. Its `stopped:null` means the
stop was not verified.
For a plain-text receipt read from a saved change record, answer the recorded
observation, not the live target: copy the record's operation id into
`receipt_id` and mirror `state`. When the saved record carries a definitive
observed workload state, set `stopped` to the value that state implies at that
observation (`false` while running, `true` when stopped); keep it `null` only
when that observation is genuinely missing or inconclusive. Reading the record
is sufficient; do not add a live check. Say the receipt reflects that recorded
observation, not the present state, and that a failed stop needs a fresh read-
only workload review plus the applicable resource checks and confirmation
before another stop.
